meta.name: kubernetes-specialist
meta.description: Use when deploying or managing Kubernetes workloads. Invoke to create deployment manifests, configure pod security policies, set up service accounts, define network isolation rules, debug pod crashes, analyze resource limits, inspect container logs, or right-size workloads. Use for Helm charts, RBAC policies, NetworkPolicies, storage configuration, performance optimization, GitOps pipelines, and multi-cluster management.

copy.tagline: 部署和管理 Kubernetes 工作负载
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理 Kubernetes 集群或部署容器化应用。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage Kubernetes clusters or deploy containerized applications.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能生成 Kubernetes 部署清单（YAML 文件），配置网络策略、RBAC 权限、存储等，并帮助排查 Pod 崩溃、资源限制等问题。
howto.when: 当你提到 Kubernetes、K8s、kubectl、Helm 等关键词，或要求部署工作负载、配置网络、管理配置、设置存储、排查集群问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个 Nginx 部署，设置资源限制和健康检查。
为我的应用配置 RBAC，只允许读取 ConfigMap。
排查这个 Pod 一直 CrashLoopBackOff 的原因。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate Kubernetes deployment manifests (YAML files), configure network policies, RBAC permissions, storage, etc., and help troubleshoot pod crashes, resource limits, and other issues.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention Kubernetes, K8s, kubectl, Helm, or similar terms, or when you ask to deploy workloads, configure networking, manage configuration, set up storage, or troubleshoot cluster issues.

say_en.text: Create an Nginx deployment with resource limits and health checks.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a Deployment YAML with probes and resource limits.

say_en.text: Configure RBAC for my app to only read ConfigMaps.
say_en.note: Claude will generate ServiceAccount, Role, and RoleBinding.

say_en.text: Troubleshoot why this Pod is in CrashLoopBackOff.
say_en.note: Claude will guide using kubectl describe and logs commands.
